_metadata.description: Controlled vocabularies and taxonomies for the Content Hub. All enumerated fields in data-schema.md must use values from this file.
_metadata.note: This file is the single source of truth for all categorical values. Modifications require pipeline review.

content_types.description: Long-form opinion or narrative content; typically 800+ words
Time-sensitive industry news, product launches, market announcements
Product/wine/spirit review with tasting notes, ratings, or formal assessment
Feature article highlighting a producer, region, or winemaker
Educational or how-to content; e.g., food pairing guides, buying guides
Columnist or expert commentary on industry trends, events, or debates
Data-driven report, market study, or scientific analysis
Video content (YouTube, social media); requires media_url

primary_categories.description: Content focused on wine (any variety, region, vintage)
Content focused on spirits (whisky, gin, rum, tequila, etc.)
Food, dining, restaurants, recipes, and culinary culture (vertical)
Luxury lifestyle content: fashion, design, watches, estates, high society (vertical)
Travel and tourism: destinations, hotels-as-stays, airlines, getaways (vertical)
Hospitality industry: hotels, resorts, foodservice, restaurant operations (vertical)
Legacy/alias: broader beverage or food content with wine/spirits context (kept so existing data validates)
Cultural or lifestyle content related to wine/spirits consumption
Content not fitting above categories but relevant to strategy

trend_signals.description: Article discusses supply shortages, allocation issues, or scarcity of a wine/spirit
Mentions price increases, market inflation, or investment opportunity based on pricing
Highlights non-traditional wine region or emerging producer gaining attention
Discusses health benefits, moderation claims, or positive health research (e.g., resveratrol)
Addresses health concerns, cancer warnings, or public health discussions
Emphasizes organic, biodynamic, natural wine, or sustainable production practices
Ties wine/spirit to cultural event, historical anniversary, or zeitgeist moment
References celebrity endorsement, celebrity-owned brand, or famous collector
Discusses wine/spirits as investment asset or collector's opportunity
Warns of counterfeit products, authentication issues, or supply chain fraud
Highlights prestigious awards, wine competition wins, or gold medals
Covers limited edition, small-batch, or exclusive release products
Content or product trending on TikTok, Instagram, or other social media
Discusses climate change effects on wine production, harvest dates, or terroir
Covers changes in laws, tariffs, labeling requirements, or trade regulations
Highlights new production technology, e-commerce model, or supply chain innovation

buyer_personas.description: General consumer; drinks wine/spirits occasionally; price-conscious; values accessibility
Regular consumer with growing knowledge; reads reviews; interested in education and discovery
Serious collector; investment-focused; seeks rare/vintage bottles; follows market closely

spirits_types.description: Whisky/whiskey (scotch, Irish, bourbon, rye, Japanese, etc.)

search_volume_estimates.description: Primary keyword has 10,000+ monthly searches or major market interest
Primary keyword has <1,000 monthly searches or niche interest
Search volume not available in SEO tools or not applicable

link_building_potential.description: High-authority source, comprehensive guide, or research-backed content; strong backlink candidate
Good editorial quality; relevant for selective linking in relevant silos
Limited link-building value; thin content or niche audience

aeo_citation_opportunity.description: Article is highly authoritative, novel research, or unique data; LLMs very likely to cite or reference
Solid editorial content with useful information; LLMs may cite in appropriate contexts
Limited citation value; opinion or promotional content; LLMs unlikely to cite
